target.development_target: the frozen R3 source-local descending midrank percentile
target.external_target: descending midrank percentile among strictly positive finite source-reported values within each PMC10257194 subject measurement batch

development_selection.population: all 2,724 frozen R3 eligible observations from the three original laboratory anchors
development_selection.tie_breaker: smaller regularization then lexical model identifier
development_selection.final_refit: fit the selected configuration on all frozen R3 development observations

external_evaluation.analysis_population: 45 paper-attached NaY-PPC subject columns with exact frozen R3 target accession mapping and strictly positive finite values
external_evaluation.access_condition: CC-BY-NC-ND-4.0 paper supplementary workbook; analysis-only local acquisition; not redistributable and not a protected lockbox

feature_policy.feature_standardization: fit only on all frozen R3 development observations

metrics.primary: equal-weight mean external subject measurement-batch Spearman correlation
secondary: equal-weight mean external subject measurement-batch mean absolute error
equal-weight mean external subject measurement-batch root mean square error
metrics.constant_rank_metric_policy: undefined; report MAE and RMSE only

uncertainty.method: external subject measurement-batch cluster bootstrap percentile interval

negative_control.method: permute R3 development targets independently within each development measurement batch while holding the observed nested-selected alpha fixed

claim_boundary: This is an author-run analysis-only OOD execution on a new laboratory paper cohort. It evaluates frozen sequence descriptors against source-local within-subject ranks without combining raw scales. It does not establish protected lockbox validation, an independent evaluator receipt, no-author scientific reproduction, community adoption or scientific submission readiness. The CC-BY-NC-ND source and numeric derivatives are excluded from redistributable release.
